notes.title: Pyrene DEMO out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Some EXCITING news - We’re finally able to share our progress with you for our next title "Pyrene" which [b]now has a playable demo[/b]! You can visit the Steam page now to try it out!

If you like it, [b]please add it to your wishlist & follow the Pyrene Steam page[/b] as it helps us a lot and [url=https://discord.gg/SE7cFZK9xk]join our Discord[/url] if you want to share your thoughts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468100/Pyrene/


"Reunite your fellow villagers to fight off the Demon Herensuge and his hordes of monsters, brought straight out of hell to terrorize the villagers. Use your deck-building skills to make it out of the unforgiving dungeons of the Pyrenees alive.

Experiment with various characters to switch abilities and traits that open up extremely varied styles of gameplay. Design elaborate strategies and make the most of the items you gather along the way to maximize your powers during every expedition."

Thank you for your consideration and we're super excited to share more with you all. Stay tuned!

- TTD

notes.title: Asylum Direct - D Day is tomorrow!
notes.content:
Hello!

Maybe some of you have heard of this event already, but tomorrow [b]January 31st at 12:30PM EST[/b], the Montreal-based Indie Asylum will showcase the [b][url=https://www.asylumdirect.com/]Asylum Direct[/url][/b].

The event will put forth indie video games from a number of different studios that compose the Indie Asylum, an indie game community working together in Montreal.

[b]What is the Asylum Direct?[/b] An online event showcasing the games of the collective. 
Here are a few things you can expect from the Asylum Direct:
• Exclusive never before seen gameplay footage
• Brand new game announcements
• Playable demos
• New Kickstarter campaigns
• Game Keys giveaway

During the event a big announcement will be made about Forward: Escape the Fold - so don't miss out!

Forward: Escape the Fold is to-date by far my most successful project yet - I can confidently say over 25,000 of you have decided to acquire the game and that's just incredible to me. The upcoming month will be rife in news for my studio and I highly recommend you follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/twotinydice]Twitter [/url]to stay up-to-date.

notes.title: Can you overcome the Spooky Halloween challenge?
notes.content:
Happy Spooktober everyone,

If you have not heard of Forward: Escape the Fold - it's a card-based roguelike where you must continuously go FORWARD in order to escape the dungeons. The game was released in March and stands at a "Very Positive" rating on Steam (with 400+ reviews). You can try it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1766390/FORWARD_Escape_the_Fold/]here[/url]!

To celebrate the Ultimate Edition of the game, I have added to the game an EXCLUSIVE challenge to the game themed around Halloween. This is a permanent event!

The challenge will consist in a 4 starting item build:
[list]
[*]Living Heart: Replaces all Heart cards with item cards
[*]Monster Skull: Adds 3 enemies in all future levels
[*]Monster Bone (x2): Gives -1 to enemy cards
[*]Healing Ring: After using your power, you heal by 4HP
[/list]

Successfully winning this challenge will award the player a NEW object card: the [b]Jack-O'-Lantern[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41413450/f1615168741e2b749582327404858cb6d72679f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Ultimate Edition now LIVE
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a while since the game got updated - the waiting ends NOW!

This update brings all the content I really wanted to bring the game and that I couldn't include earlier. Without further ado, here are the update notes:

[list]
[*]1 NEW Character with 3 unique powers
[*]14 NEW items
[*]3 NEW Challenges
[*]1 NEW Status Recovery
[*]Some NEW secrets (I hope you find it!)
[*]a LOT of balancing from characters to items and powers
[/list]


This update signals the ultimate version of the game - meaning, I believe I have built the game I wanted to make and will be creating very little new content from this point onwards. I will happily fix the game if needed but will be focusing my attention on my next game!

In addition, as I discussed on DIscord, in the near future there will be a mobile port of the game! Keep your eyes peeled for that :)

Thank you to everyone who played the game and it was a brilliant adventure!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 - New items, New Challenges & more
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0 was launched on Sunday but there were some bugs found by the Discord community very quickly. So I implemented a hot-fix soon after which is update 1.1.1 - decided to stall the announcement to make sure there weren't any new issues discovered.

Now though I'm confident it's time for you guys to try it out for yourselves :) There's a lot of new stuff to try and I hope you'll enjoy trying out the new objects and challenges especially!

[b]Don't forget to join the game's [u][url=https://discord.gg/mynGNdqtmx][b]Discord[/b][/url][/u] to chat with other players and discuss proposals for the game!
[/b]
Here are some of the major changes to the game:

- 14 NEW items that will definitely switch things up during your runs
- 2 NEW challenges
- The Darkness challenge will now begin with 2 Gorgon Eyes 😵
- You can now leave corrupted chests for 5 HP (thought this would add some extra strategy!)
- Non-stackable items will no longer appear if you already have one in your inventory (no more frustration!!)
- Reworked items that trigger power (i.e rings)
- Removed feedback button

As for balancing changes:

- Increased the overall difficulty (I follow internally win rates to figure out the right balance)
- For Azerty, the Iron Block is now a stackable item
- For Phade, the Return power now leaves a sword card instead of a road card
- For Raven, the Armor power now costs 4 instead of 7 mana

In addition, I wanted to say I'm working on bigger patches for the next weeks/months with LOTS of new content, here are a few things I'm working on:

- Endless Mode - highly requested! I’m working on finding the right balance for this mode and how to make it worthwhile
- Draft Mode - where you would build an inventory at the beginning of the run and face the Fold with it. This might be a separate mode or a new character
- More achievements - why not right?
- A new level type where you can pick a new power
- and obviously, NEW characters!

Thank you for all the support and I can't wait to continue improving the game!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:

notes.title: First Update - Fixing some player issues and some more balancing!
notes.content:
First update since the release of the game. It adds few features and mostly fixes bugs and character balancing. I'll be making more of theses updates to keep the game balanced and will be adding more content soon!

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*]New item: Vitality Dagger
[*]New experimental setting allowing to right click on a card to move on it.
[*]New experimental setting allowing to use keyboard to move.
[*]Chests/stores no longer trigger statuses.
[*]Chests will always have different cards.
[*]Clearer pause menu buttons.
[*]Bosses always drop heart card.
[*]Statuses can no longer exceed 999.
[*]Personal best score at the end of the game.
[*]Rework “So close” achievement.
[*]New changelog screen.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]

Phade:
[list]
[*]+3 HP
[*]Absorption now costs 5 instead of 6 and absorbs 3 health points instead of 2.
[/list]
Anubis:
[list]
[*]+1 HP
[/list]
Silence:
[list]
[*]Starts with an additional item: Vitality Dagger
[/list]
Azerty
[list]
[*]Starts with 24 armor instead of 20.
[*]Iron block item now gives 10 armor instead of 6.
[*]Beat the iron power now changes 4 random cards instead of 2.
[*]Repair power become Heart of steel with a totally different effect.
[/list]

[b]Bug fix[/b]
It was sometimes impossible to start a level (bug with the amber item and the immunity status).
Correction of (too many) spelling mistakes.

I have more exciting content on the way! All this feedback has been so motivating for me and I can't see myself stopping updating the game anytime soon :)

Christophe Coyard

notes.title: Forward: Escape the Fold is now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it’s [b]launch day[/b]!

Forward: Escape the Fold has just released and I (Christophe, the dev!) wanted to sum up what’s happened to the game to this day and where it is heading over the next months. First, the game today is a full release and has already tons of modes, characters to plays and items to collect but will be receiving regular updates to spice it up for players who enjoy the game.

For those of you who are new to Forward: Escape the Fold, it’s a card-based dungeon crawler roguelite that lets the player face a series of increasingly challenging dungeons where they will need to make hard decisions at every turn. They will need to collect objects scattered in the dungeons to power up and create fun synergies. The rest you can discover by playing the game ;)

The game concept was originally conceived during the 2019 7DRL Game Jam where my game ranked 6th overall! Seeing that players were really enjoying that small game I decided to take the mechanics and make a full-fledged game. And that’s how Forward: Escape the Fold came around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41413450/e0cac9ea654042c43d88d7496a2df0a778ffada6.png[/img]

I am really excited to see how players react to the game this week and take into account their feedback for future updates. I already have some things planned for the upcoming months including:

- New Characters (I already have some ideas)
- New Items (more synergies to come!)
- Continued balancing (depending on how players react)
- Integrating Steam functionalities

So all that being said, I hope you guys enjoy the game and i will always be there to answer any questions you may have (My Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/twotinydice]@twotinydice[/url]). 

And last thing, if you feel like it, you can drop a review on Steam! It helps a lot for visibility :)

But remember KEEP GOING FORWARD ;)

notes.title: Playtest wrap-up
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The past few weeks have been incredible and the playtest went really well. Over 50 of you responded to the beta with feedback which is so important to me. At the moment, I am planning on releasing the game in March so all this feedback will be used to make the final game as good as it can. 

I thought it could be interesting to run you down some of the main points I received from all of you:

[list]
[*]The font used was too hard for many of you to read. I will be definitely changing this so that no one struggles reading information on screen. I’ll make different font options.
[*]The display of the inventory needs to use more space on-screen so that the player does not need to double-click to see the objects he has. Overall, I will be rethinking the display so that more information is readable at a glance.
[*]The enemies lack variety. I will be trying out different methods to make them more unique such as giving them specific powers to make the experience more interesting.
[/list]
In addition, many people pointed out balancing issues so that will also be a main focus point of my work for the next month! 

[b]I’m excited to announce that during January I will open a Kickstarter campaign to attract more visibility on the project.[/b] If you enjoyed the playtest, I suggest you check the page for the campaign as I will be offering a discounted price on the final game for the backers! There will also be a sign-up for the next playtest once I’ve reworked these elements.

Lastly, I can’t thank enough the 178 of you who played the game over the past few weeks :) This means the world to me!
